# HexY repository instructions

Read and follow the repository's existing instructions rather than duplicating
or replacing them:

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): coding standards and developer working discipline.
- [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md): agreed product behavior and constraints.
- [IMPLEMENTATION_PHASES.md](../IMPLEMENTATION_PHASES.md): current phase, blockers,
  acceptance gates and handoff.
- [REVIEW.md](../REVIEW.md): independent review criteria and reporting.

For implementation, stay within the current approved phase. For reviews, apply
the review criteria to the relevant changes without modifying the implementation.
Do not treat passing tests alone as phase clearance.
